question.text: The ratio of mass percent of C and H of an organic compound  <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math>  is 6 : 1. If one molecule of the above compound  <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math>  contains half as much oxygen as required to burn one molecule of compound  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></mrow></msub></math>  completely to  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math>  and  <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math> . The empirical formula of compound   <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">X</mi></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Y</mi></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Z</mi></mrow></msub></math>  is

solution.text:
Ratio of mass % of C and H in CXHYOZ is 6 : 1.

Therefore, Ratio of mole % of C and H in CXHYOZ will be 1 : 2.

Therefore x : y = 1 : 2, which is possible in options 1, 2 and 3.

Now oxygen required to burn CXHY

CXHY+x+y4O2→xCO2+y2H2O

Now z is half of oxygen atoms required to burn CXHY

So Z=2X+Y22=X+Y4

Now putting values of x and y from the given options

Option A, x=2,y=4

Z=2+44=3

Option B, x=3,y=6

Z=3+64=4.5

Therefore correct option is 1 C2H4O3
